TEXT: I arrived at the Game Center in front of the station.
The place is as noisy as ever.

For starters, I'll check the fighting game corner 
where she's likely to be.

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT: [font_size=28]Whoaa! Finally, a 100-win streak![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_2
TEXT: She's ridiculously strong! And a beauty too...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh...
Could that be Kuroneko?

I made my way through the crowd, trying to catch 
a glimpse of this female gamer who achieved a 
100-win streak.
However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Not her.

There seems to be female gamers who are as 
skilled as Kuroneko.
Maybe she's the one Sena was talking about.
Well, that's the least of my worries right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Can't find her.
Is she even in here?

In the midst of giving up and having no luck, I 
headed to the remaining medal game corner.
When I arrived...

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_4
TEXT: You're doing it!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_4
TEXT:
Kuroneko-san! You are a genius! Indeed, the cat 
that descended to darkness...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Whoa now... That voice sounds so familiar.
I approached the voice in a hurry and-
...it was this very scene you see here.
Hey... What does one make of this?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Hmph... You shouldn't be surprised over something 
as trivial as this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Look, here it comes again.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: [font_size=44]Kyaaa!①[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
Beautiful! How did you do that?! It's not just 
targeting a winning sequence, right?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Fufu... It's intuition. I am sensing the waves of 
darkness.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
I don't really understand but that doesn't matter! 
As expected of Kuroneko-san!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
My current form is not known as Kuroneko, but 
Yamineko. Please don't be mistaken.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: Yes, Yamineko-san, right? Okay, okay!

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
Hey, so, can you do the same with the other 
machines too?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: A simple task.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
[font_size=33]Impressive! I love you, 
Kuroneko-san![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Please stop saying such disgusting things.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
Kufufufu... *slurp*! If I can use this girl's skills, I'll 
definitely be riding the gravy train! Victory! The 
ending of Oreimo!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What are you doing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [font_size=44]!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
O-Oh, I thought it was some random person but it's 
just Kyousuke-kun. What's up?

...Uh, there may be people who might not recognize 
her, so I'll explain.

This money-monger of a woman is Iori Fate 
Setsuna.

Many things happened and she became 
unemployed, a Legendary Freeter, one who 
survives through part-time jobs.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What do you mean "what's up?" What are you 
doing in a place like this?

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: Can't you tell by looking? I'm hitting the slots!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I can tell! I don't mean that, but about what you're 
scheming while embracing Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
You've seen it too, haven't you? That impossible 
Super Winning Sequence Technique!

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
If it's her, she can easily conquer it! That thing 
which ruined so many gamblers, that-

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay stop right there.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
Aw, what's with you? I was getting to the good 
part.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I get the gist of it, even if you don't say it.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: Well! In that case, this discussion is simple!

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: That's how it is, so please pray for our success.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]Like hell I will![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Please don't involve Kuroneko in your shady 
scheme.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: But it's not a shady scheme~

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: It's gambling your life away for the final victory~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's even worse!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
*sigh*... Come on, let's go, Kuroneko. You shouldn't 
associate yourself with such people.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Kuroneko? Who might that be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I am the angel of vengeance "Yamineko"... An 
abominable being whose heart was ruined by the 
darkness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Leave, human. I shall continue down this path of 
destruction.
Not good.
Kuroneko is straying from the right path.

I had my suspicions that she's slightly off from 
usual, going by what Hinata-chan said, but-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph. I've told you already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Right now... I'm the angel of vengeance, Yamineko.
Ah, so she hasn't recovered from that yet.
In fact, it looks like things might be getting worse.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: See? You heard her, didn't you?
Fate-san pointed sternly at my face.

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: Humans like you should just go back home!

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT:
Yes, we are fallen angels, staking our lives in this 
game of darkness...

SPEAKER: SPK_FATE
TEXT: This is no place for the likes of you.
She has regressed, she has regressed!
Even this one has regressed into a middle schooler!
This aura of "Yamineko" is terrifying.
The "sickness" known as Chuunibyou...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...This isn't contagious, right?
